titles.english: Zenless Zone Zero: The Path to Becoming a Hero
titles.native: 绝区零 成为英雄的旅程

description:
—"Oh? Does my little Miyabi know what it really means to be a hero?"
—"To destroy all the bad guys!"
—"Heroes aren't born to destroy, Miyabi. They're born to protect."

(Source: Zenless Zone Zero YouTube Channel)
